name: codex-conversation-tree
description: Embed a local, read-only conversation tree in the official Codex window on Windows.

interface.shortDescription: View real task lineage in the official Codex window.
interface.longDescription: Adds a local, read-only conversation tree to the user's existing official Codex window, keeps manual thread names in sync, and never creates a second conversation store.
defaultPrompt: Explain how Codex thread branches are displayed.
